review_type: Independent deep static source review; no Rust type/runtime qualification
conclusion: No remaining current-code blocker found in the reviewed retained ownership/accounting delta after the definite-prewrite Closed correction.

static_invariants_reviewed.invariant: Accepted payloads are published to a Worker owner before each newly introduced suspension. Completion removes only one Pending for a synchronous callback or retry-channel handoff.

Sticky retirement, whole-batch byte release, batch metrics and ack latency have durable progress flags. Cancellation before byte release recomputes the charge; cancellation after callback prefix does not subtract it again. Metadata indices, stamps and latency state persist.
Sticky record permits stay in Pending through callback dispatch, and WorkerLease remains the final Worker field, so callback cleanup retains worker liveness.

Retry grouping, maximum backoff, first-refresh index, original record index and transfer cursor persist across cancellation. Rejected retry tickets remain counted through callbacks and are removed afterwards; expired records create no ticket.
Stable splitting retains records in Worker pending/selected fields; tracked permutation restoration precedes appending newer channel records on Drop. Both normal partition sides preserve order.

The read/decode guard hands accepted groups to Worker.responding before endpoint/index awaits; Worker.response_current and response_groups retain current and later groups across identity-renewal awaits.

Vec-to-VecDeque conversions and empty-shell return preserve reusable allocations; front pops are constant-time. New split metadata uses operation-level index vectors, without per-record payload copies, Arc wrappers, ownership cycles or quadratic permutation walks.

resolved_findings.issue: Blanket removal of post-write-call rollback also removed rollback for Error::Closed, which current BrokerConn returns at its entry check before entering the write pump. Permanently failing that unwritten batch could leave an unfilled same-identity sequence reservation.
resolved_findings.correction: producer.rs:8447-8453 now rolls back only Error::Closed and clears preparing.write_started for that known-unwritten result. Io/Timeout keep their sequence and take the existing retry path.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial added controls did not exercise retry expiry or Full/Closed rejection through the new terminal path.
resolved_findings.correction: Three real-path controls now hold mpsc capacity with reservations, close admission, or expire records; they assert callback-visible ticket scope and suffix cleanup balance.

remaining_nonblocking_coverage_gaps: The narrow real transport prewrite Error::Closed correction is justified by static transport inspection; no new deterministic native regression control for that exact race was run.
New failure cancellation controls use one topic; mixed-topic failure accounting and multi-topic retry index continuation were reviewed in source but are not separately added controls.

latest_stable_rustfmt_check.scope: five candidate source files; syntax and formatting only

limits: No candidate Rust build, native execution, Cargo invocation, test execution, repository source mutation or push performed by this review.
Static approval does not establish compilation, test passing, timing or end-to-end producer correctness.
Physical socket retirement before replay, global cross-request issue ordering, sequence wrap, and PID/epoch reconciliation/replay policy remain deferred.
Any future ambiguous non-retriable terminal-write result needs an explicit continuation/fencing decision; retaining a sequence alone does not solve that policy.
The author-provided Python split proof models logical permutation/restoration; it is not compiled Rust execution.
